responseText:
I can tell you it's a mighty fine place to take up residence if you're looking for a place to stay. 

The bulletin board will tell you all about the new buildings being built and the mayor's ongoing commissions. It's not without its dues and taxes, mind you, but I reckon you'll find them reasonable nonetheless. 

If there are important matters of awareness, such as upcoming wars or sieges they'll be posted here.
